jobs.prompt: LOCKED full-body wide camera. Keep all six beautiful toy characters exactly as shown, all heads and shoes in view. All six perform one synchronized little dance: first lift one hand to say here; then place that palm against the chest; then lift the right heel and stamp it down firmly with a small knee bend and visible weight transfer; then a small toe tap and settle. Supporting feet stay planted. No walking, no spins, no camera move, no cuts, no text, no speech. Maintain distinct identities, clean grounded foot contact and natural limb articulation. Refined animation with warm soft studio lighting.
